what.text: This page follows refugees from Albania living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4776 Albanian refugees in the United Kingdom, 22.3% of all refugees from Albania.
France hosts the most Albanian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Albania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1999 at 25 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5330, at the end of 2023, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
